lines: Long ago, there was a man living in a small village.
He was not happy because he always had many problems in his life.
One day, a wise saint visited the village.
Many people hurried to meet the saint and share their troubles.
The man also decided to talk to him.
Even though he arrived at the saint’s room in the morning, he had to wait until evening to meet him.
When he finally met the saint, he said he was unhappy because problems always surrounded him, like stress at work or worries about his health.
He said, “Please give me a solution so that all the problems in my life will end and I can live peacefully.”
The saint smiled and said, “I will respond to your request tomorrow.”
But the saint also asked the man to do a small job—to take care of 100 camels that night.
The saint said, “When all 100 camels sit down, you can go to sleep.”
The next morning, when the saint met the man, he asked if the man slept well.
The man replied, “I couldn’t sleep at all last night.”
In fact, the man tried his best but couldn’t make all the camels sit at the same time.
Every time he made one camel sit, another stood up.
The saint told him, “Even though you tried hard, you couldn’t make all the camels sit down.
If one problem is solved, another will arise like the camels did.
So you should enjoy life, even with its problems.”
